description: Refactor and harden the J.A.R.V.I.S. Android system audio stack to eliminate volume degradation hazards, routing leaks, and focus orphan defects.

userStories.title: Update MediaDuckingManager and VoiceAudioFocusManager
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the media ducking logic to rely on OS transient focus instead of hardcoded volume overrides to prevent permanent volume degradation.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove explicit am.setStreamVolume(STREAM_MUSIC, ...) logic from MediaDuckingManager
Rely on VoiceAudioFocusManager.requestDuckFocus() to acquire AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK
Reuse AudioFocusRequest instances in VoiceAudioFocusManager instead of overwriting active ones

userStories.title: Ensure Audio Focus release on Engine Teardown

acceptanceCriteria: Add mediaDuckingManager.restoreVolume() to VoiceEngine.close()
Add audioFocus.abandon() to AndroidTtsEngine.cancel()
Remove am.setCommunicationDevice() calls during recognizer initialization in AndroidSpeechRecognizerEngine

Save previousAudioMode and tracked ownedCommunicationDeviceId in BluetoothHeadsetManager
